description: E21-b — THIS repository's experiment recipes, as data. The kernel's bench (aria_kernel.experiment) knows no language and no product noun; every domain-shaped value the bench will ever execute lives in this file. Adding a recipe is an edit here, never a kernel change. tools/aria-poc/invariants/test_experiment_recipes_manifest.py proves each command below is executable by aria_kernel.validation.parse_allowed_command, so a recipe this lane would refuse cannot reach a nightly.

recipes.description: The backend-common Jest suite. It contains ORPHAN-HIGH-691's two regression specs (database-logging-resolution.spec.ts and source-schema-scanner-coverage.spec.ts, both added by commit b222dab17), so this recipe is a solution-experiment against a finding that actually landed rather than a synthetic green. Written as run-many because aria_kernel.validation admits `npx nx affected` and `npx nx run-many` only; `npx nx test <project>` is refused by the lane. --skip-nx-cache is mandatory: a cached replay records a green exit code without executing a single test, so an experiment that may be answered from the cache measures the cache and not the tree. --output-style=stream is mandatory for its sibling reason: measured on this repository, nx's default non-TTY renderer wrote 63 KB of a 161 KB run into the captured stream and cut it mid-escape-sequence, losing the Jest summary and 80 of the 124 suite results — so the hash-bound log, which is what verify_validation_run re-checks and what any log_contains comparator would read, was evidence of a run nobody could reconstruct. Streamed, the log carries all 124 suites, `Tests: 1369 passed` and both ORPHAN-691 specs.

The Rust lane's first real recipe. alarm-core is the crate sens-api-gateway/Cargo.toml consumes by path (alarm-core = { path = "../crates/alarm-core" }) — the drift-zero alarm decision core shared by the Rust edge agent and the TypeScript SCADA runtime. It is chosen over the edge agent's own package (suderra-agent) because alarm-core declares zero normal dependencies, so `cargo check -p alarm-core` compiles one crate and nothing else; checking suderra-agent would compile tokio-full, reqwest, rustls and rumqttc and grow target/ by gigabytes on a host that has hit 100% disk.

experiments.hypothesis: ORPHAN-HIGH-691's regression specs still pass on this tree, so the source-schema-scanner coverage fix and the DATABASE_LOGGING resolution are still enforced by tests rather than by memory.

The same bench that runs a TypeScript recipe runs a Rust one with no kernel change — the domain lives in this manifest, so the alarm decision core type-checks through the identical validation-run path.
a finding-bound problem experiment runs RED against backend-common when the defect is present (hand-authored exemplar of the shape experiment_author mints)
